note: Synthetic, non-private Discord-safe campaign message samples for the WP10 real googletrans benchmark. No user data, no real Guild/channel/message ids. Natively authored (not machine-translated) in each of the four languages so the full directed FR/EN/DE/ES matrix has genuine, non-circular source content in every direction, per REQ-MSG-024.

en.content: Welcome to the server! We are excited to have you here.
Hey <@123456789012345678>, welcome! Please read the rules in <#234567890123456789> and say hi to <@&345678901234567890> members.
Check out our new announcement at https://example.com/campaign?ref=discord for full details.

Run `campaign.publish()` to go live, or use the ```py
campaign.schedule(rrule="FREQ=DAILY")
``` snippet for recurring sends.
Hi {{member_name}}, your registration for {{event_name}} is confirmed for {{event_date}}.
Hey <@123456789012345678>! Your event {{event_name}} starts <t:1735689600:F>. Details: https://example.com/e/{{event_id}} -- use `!rsvp` in <#234567890123456789>.
